courses.subject: HHM
courses.title: Introduction to Humanities, Health, and Medicine
courses.description: Survey the history, aims, and challenges of the field of humanities, health, and medicine, as well as the field's current role in health-professional education and practice. Explore subfields within the health humanities such as the history of medicine, narrative medicine, literature and medicine, medical anthropology, disability studies, medicine and the arts, and bioethics. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
